title: Ordering nodal branches makes their vertical ideals agree generically on overlaps
statement:
Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-weil-field, def-kun-separably-closed], and $V\subseteq K$ a valuation ring with fraction field $K$, meaning that $a$ or $a^{-1}$ lies in $V$ for every $a\in K^\times$. Assume that its primes form a finite chain, and put $S=\operatorname{Spec}V$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $X$ be an affine flat finitely presented $S$-scheme with pure one-dimensional geometric fibres [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation, def-weil-geometric-fibre, def-weil-pure-dimension]. Assume that every nonsmooth geometric fibre point has completed local ring $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$ over its algebraically closed residue field [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Assume that each reduced irreducible component of each fibre $X_s$ is smooth over $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-irreducible-components, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme, def-weil-residue-field]. Fix an affine scheme $Y$, etale $S$-morphisms $p:Y\to X$ and $h:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}V[u,v]/(uv-c)$ with $0\ne c\in V$ [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-polynomial-ring], and a point $y\in Y$ such that $x=p(y)$ is nonsmooth and $u(h(y))=v(h(y))=0$. There exist affine Zariski opens $x\in U\subseteq X$ and $y\in Y_0\subseteq p^{-1}(U)$ such that $p_0:Y_0\to U$ is surjective. Put $W=Y_0\times_UY_0$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $r_1,r_2$, and denote the restricted coordinate functions $h^*u,h^*v$ on $Y_0$ by $u_0,v_0$. For every $s\in S$ and generic point $\xi$ of every irreducible component of $W_s$, one has
$$(r_1^*u_0)\mathcal O_{W,\xi}=(r_2^*u_0)\mathcal O_{W,\xi},\qquad (r_1^*v_0)\mathcal O_{W,\xi}=(r_2^*v_0)\mathcal O_{W,\xi}.$$
No descent of these ideals to $U$, or etale map from $U$ to a standard nodal model, is asserted.
